fraud-detection was scaled to zero and back to one a few minutes ago, so the consumer group had no member for about three minutes (until the new pod's JVM started and joined), which fired the alert. The orders that arrived meanwhile (a handful) were consumed as soon as the new pod joined: the group has one active member and its lag is about zero, accounting is unaffected and checkout works. The alert is stale and nothing needs to be changed; who scaled the Deployment is worth a follow-up, but not a change.
